integrity: All sharpness and equality statements are proved analytically; finite checks are corroborative and are not used as substitutes for the all-parameter argument.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to two distinct characters and even integer exponents.
No claim is made for non-even exponents or spectra with three or more characters.
An older equivalent formulation under different finite-group notation remains a residual literature risk.
title: Exact even-moment constants for a finite-order character pair
